topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I stood there, the driveway empty and bare, the silence almost tangible. The spot where my car usually sat was now just a patch of cold asphalt, mocking the normalcy of my morning. It’s not like I hadn’t placed the 'No Towing' sign out there, its red letters stark against the gray morning. The note on the windshield of the car next door, crumpled and discarded, told a story of a misunderstanding, perhaps a nefarious intent. I traced the outline of the space with my foot, each step feeling heavier than the last. The neighbors avoided eye contact, their morning greetings unusually quiet. I tried to piece together the logic, but the puzzle was missing key pieces, leaving only a hollow spot where my car used to be.
